job.spec: A5 148x210mm, 4/4, 3mm bleed, 5mm safety margin, 300ppi, PDF/X-1a:2001, FOGRA39, litho on 300gsm silk
job.context: File supplied is PRINT ARTWORK, so it is graded against print-readiness in full. This is a synthetic example with eleven deliberately seeded faults.

checks_skipped.reason: no raster images placed in this document

unverified: Overset text — cannot be detected in a PDF. Check the InDesign source.
Brand compliance — no guidelines supplied for Acme Stores.
Copy accuracy against an approved deck — no copy deck supplied, so only internal consistency was checked.
Regulatory and promotional terms — flagged for a human specialist, not assessed.
Colour appearance on 300gsm silk — cannot be assessed without a proof.

findings.title: No bleed anywhere in the document
findings.detail: MediaBox is 419.53 x 595.28pt (148 x 210mm) with no TrimBox or BleedBox set. The black band on page 1 is built to the trim edge, so any cutting tolerance will show a white sliver.
findings.action: Set a 3mm bleed and extend the black band and any other edge-bleeding element into it. Re-export with crop marks and 3mm bleed.

findings.title: Entire document is DeviceRGB in a CMYK job
findings.detail: Every fill and stroke resolves to DeviceRGB. No output intent is embedded. Spec calls for CMYK with FOGRA39.
findings.action: Set the document to CMYK, convert or rebuild all colours, and export PDF/X-1a:2001 with FOGRA39 as the output intent.

findings.title: Day of week does not match the date
findings.detail: Reads 'Thursday 4 April 2026'. 4 April 2026 is a Saturday.
findings.action: Confirm the intended date with the client, then correct either the day or the date. Check the same date wherever else it appears.

findings.title: Bundle price does not add up
findings.detail: Jacket £45 + Shirt £30 + Belt £20 = £95. Stated bundle price is £90. Either the arithmetic is wrong or the £5 saving is undeclared.
findings.action: Confirm the intended bundle price. If £90 is correct, state the saving explicitly so the offer is not misleading.

findings.title: Phone number differs between pages
findings.detail: Page 1 reads 01522 511 900. Page 2 reads 01522 511 090. Both are valid UK Lincoln formats, so neither can be ruled out by format alone.
findings.action: Verify the correct number with the client and dial it before print. Correct both pages to match.

findings.title: Reversed body copy set at 5pt
findings.detail: White text on a solid black ground at 5pt. Below the 6pt minimum for reversed type on coated litho, and the light weight will fill in.
findings.action: Increase to 7pt minimum and step up one weight, or move the copy off the black ground.

findings.title: Hairline rule at 0.15pt
findings.detail: Rule measures 0.15pt. Minimum reliable positive line on coated litho is 0.25pt. It may print broken or disappear.
findings.action: Increase to 0.25pt minimum, 0.5pt if the stock turns out to be uncoated.

findings.title: Hyphen used for a date range
findings.detail: Reads '3rd-14th of April'. A range takes an en dash, not a hyphen.
findings.action: Replace with an en dash. Check every other range in the document.

findings.title: Double space after a full stop
findings.detail: One instance, after 'sale.' — a typewriter habit that leaves a visible hole in the line.
findings.action: Find/change double space to single space across the document.

findings.title: Straight apostrophes, 3 instances
findings.detail: It's, we've and we'll all use a straight prime rather than a typographer's apostrophe.
findings.action: Enable typographer's quotes and find/change all instances.

findings.title: Phone number differs from page 1
findings.action: Correct to match once the client confirms the right number.

findings.title: Terms copy inside the safety margin
findings.detail: Text box sits 4mm from trim on left, right and bottom. Spec requires a 5mm safety margin. On a guillotine tolerance of ±1mm this could be trimmed into.
findings.action: Pull in to 5mm minimum from trim on all edges.

findings.title: Not a PDF/X file
findings.detail: PDF 1.7, no output intent, no PDF/X identification. Spec asks for PDF/X-1a:2001.
findings.action: Export from the source using the PDF/X-1a:2001 preset once the colour and bleed findings are resolved.
